name: toneperfect
description: Pronunciation assessment API, 10 languages: sentence, word and sound scores for a recording of a known text.
long_description:
Connects Claude to the TonePerfect pronunciation assessment API. Give it a short recording (up to 30 s) of someone reading a known text plus that text, and it returns 0-100 display grades for the recording, every word and every sound, with expected vs heard values and timings. Mandarin gets a separate initial, final and tone score per syllable.

Ten languages: Mandarin Chinese, English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Korean (beta) and Japanese (beta). Scripted speech only: it scores reading of a given text, not free conversation.

Needs an API key: new accounts get 50 free credits, no card needed (https://api.toneperfect.app/signup). Plans start at $10/month. One credit per started 15 seconds of assessable audio; unassessable recordings cost nothing.
